    pub async fn compute_signature(&self) -> Result<DatasetSignature> {
        let entity_sig = self.node_signature("Entity").await?;
        let episodic_sig = self.node_signature("Episodic").await?;
        let community_sig = self.node_signature("Community").await?;

        let max_updated = [

            community_sig.count,
            edge_sig.count,

            count: total_count,
            max_updated_at: max_updated,
        })
    }
